tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: The map ground and page background. Lowest tonal level; everything floats above it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebars, drawers and the command bar. Default container level (Material tonal level 1).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows and tonal buttons resting on surface-1.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menus, chips and anything one step above surface-2. Highest opaque level.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of floating panels over the map, always with backdrop-filter blur(var(--blur-md)) and a glass-stroke border. Text on glass is ink or ink-muted; the panel reads as surface-1 for contrast purposes.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a glass panel; also the inset highlight at its top edge. Decorative, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: outline buttons, text-field edges, toggle tracks at rest. 3:1 on surface-0 through surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and on glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and metadata on every surface and on glass.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 only; not on surface-3.

tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: The command accent, a cyan-leaning blue: filled primary button, active tab indicator, selected state. As text, on every surface. At most one filled azure action per view.

tokens.name: on-azure
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an azure fill. Never literal white or black.

tokens.name: azure-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind azure text: tonal buttons, selected chips, selected rows.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: The data accent, a teal cyan kept apart from azure by leaning green: live values, links, the focus ring, own-position and track lines on the map. As text, on every surface.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cyan fill.

tokens.name: cyan-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cyan text: info badges, readout highlights.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Running, connected, nominal. As text on every surface; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Faulted, destroyed, destructive actions. As text on every surface; differs from success in lightness as well as hue, and always carries a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and paused state. As text on every surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Degraded, attention. A status amber used only in Badges, Alerts and map alert markers, never as a brand accent. As text on every surface.

tokens.name: warning-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill (map alert markers).

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Material state layer painted over a control on hover.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer on press and on keyboard activation.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring offset 2px from the control, so it sits on the surface, never on the control's own fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: affil-friend
tokens.usage: APP-6D friendly fill (light: the standard dark variant). Symbol and track fills only, with a symbol-frame stroke; never text. The light value is 2.4:1 on surface-1 and relies on its frame.

tokens.name: affil-hostile
tokens.usage: APP-6D hostile fill. Symbol and track fills only, framed by symbol-frame; never text.

tokens.name: affil-neutral
tokens.usage: APP-6D neutral fill. Symbol and track fills only, framed by symbol-frame; never text. The light value is 3.1:1 on surface-1 and relies on its frame.

tokens.name: affil-unknown
tokens.usage: APP-6D unknown fill. Symbol and track fills only, framed by symbol-frame; never text. 1.3:1 on light surfaces: the frame is what makes it visible.

tokens.name: symbol-frame
tokens.usage: 1.5px frame around every affiliation fill and the ink of a symbol's modifiers. Guarantees every symbol is visible on both themes.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Scenario titles on the start screen and cover.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Section headers inside a panel; list group headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Entities keep their last known position until the next state update arrives.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Assign a route, then set the march speed.
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, forms, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Entity names and emphasised values inline with body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels, column headers, chip text. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a value. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The one big number of a Readout tile: sim clock, entity count, rate.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Coordinates and headings in panel headers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tabular values, identifiers, timestamps, DIS entity IDs. Tabular figures: use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Containers pad with space-4; dense tactical lists pad with space-2 and space-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a chip; hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; vertical padding of a dense list row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of chips and small buttons; gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on narrow layouts; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Control height of the command bar's main row.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Command bar total height; page gutters on wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top margin of a page title; empty-state padding.

rowHeight.note: Fixed heights of virtualised list rows (ADR 0072). Whole pixels on the 4px grid, each at least the 24px minimum target size. src/model/rowHeights.ts mirrors these values and a test keeps the two equal.

tokens.name: row-sm
tokens.usage: One dense log line in data style 13/18; 28px keeps it on the 4px grid and above the 24px target size.

tokens.name: row-md
tokens.usage: One single-line entity row in data style 13/18 (name, id or value) with comfortable padding; on the 4px grid, above the 24px target size.

tokens.name: row-lg
tokens.usage: A two-line row: body 14/20 plus caption 12/16 (36px of text) with space-2 above and below, rounded up to the 4px grid.

radius.note: Material 3 scale. Containers round generously; controls inside them round one step less; data cells stay sharp.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, table cells, the toggle thumb's inner highlight, affiliation tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, chips, readout tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and list containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels floating over the map; dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The command bar when floating; bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggles, avatars, pill chips.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly tonal (surface-1 to surface-3). Shadows appear only on glass panels and menus that float over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass panels: an inset top highlight plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Alternative focus treatment for controls that cannot use outline-offset (range thumbs). A 2px gap in surface-0 then the 2px focus-ring.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small badges over the map.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Glass panels and the floating command bar.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control content.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: opacity-track
tokens.usage: Historic track lines on the map; stale entities.

duration.note: Motion is short and functional. Nothing in the tactical display animates for decoration; live values change instantly.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: State layers, toggles, chip selection.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panel open and close, tab indicator slide.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet entry.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Material standard easing; every transition unless noted.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Dismissals and closes.
